text: Active criterion `ac-zapis-strony-wprowadzajacy-nowy-naglo` states, as expected behaviour, that a page write introducing a new heading returns a `hash` computed BEFORE the indexer injects anchors, so the next write armed with it ends in PAGE_CONFLICT. That contradicts `page-tools-update-page.logic` at 2.1.8 ("`hash` i `version` w zwrotce są stanem po osiadnięciu") and `put-api-pages` ("Odpowiedź niesie stan po osiadnięciu"). The code follows the entities: the returned hash is the settled one and arms the next write; the test tagged with the criterion (src/server/services/page-write.test.ts, describe `[ac:ac-zapis-strony-wprowadzajacy-nowy-naglo]`) asserts the next write succeeds. The criterion reads as a recorded defect (0.2.75 known edge case) rather than a requirement. Suggestion: reword it to the settled-hash rule ("the hash a write returns arms the next write, even when the write introduced a heading") or retire it.
